All objectives complete and verified.

**Final report**

1. **DONE** — Ticket `sbatch1 RD Bench Ticket` created (ref **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer"), confirmed present in the tickets list after refresh.
2. **DONE** — Part `sbatch1 RD Part A` (cost 100, markup 25) added; app-computed price: **$125.00**.

Precondition discovered: the app blocked the first attempt with the message *"Ticket is not ready Part "sbatch1 RD Part A" has no supplier Part "sbatch1 RD Part B" has no supplier"* — i.e. **every part on the ticket must have a supplier assigned**. I set supplier "Bench Supplier" on both parts, then "Mark Ready" succeeded; page showed "Status Ready".
